entries.columnsContract: `shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, ordinal, material_key, role(primary_payload|structural_dependency|metadata_sidecar|poster|fanart|subtitle|external_audio|chapter|sidecar), episode_claims_schema_ref, episode_claims_json, episode_claim_set_digest, endpoint_id, location, binding_revision, mount_scope_id, inode, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, digest_hex, size_bytes, artifact_scope_schema_ref NULL, artifact_scope_json NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(shelf_entry_id,inventory_revision,ordinal)`；每个物理Material在一版Inventory中只有一row，active representation中Primary Material全局exclusive partial unique；每row必须逐字保存完整`PhysicalMaterialIdentity@2` tuple，且`material_key`必须等于该tuple的canonical digest，使文件已经missing时Aftercare仍能签发精确Control release。最终物化的Related/Artifact与Primary一样必须作为Target-contained Inventory Material row，不能只保留外部Reference。Episode JSON固定`helix://contracts/application-types/ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims/v1`、canonical JCS≤`16 KiB`且三列均非NULL，由同一On-deck Run verified `StagedInventoryManifest@1` member逐字节复制；Inventory Representation与Deck Fact digest覆盖完整typed Set，历史revision从本row独立重建，不得复制多条Material row表达多个Episode；`artifact_scope_json`仅Series NFO保存Arca内部`helix://arca/inventory-artifact-scope/v1` closed JCS（≤4 KiB）：schemaVersion=1、artifactKind=nfo、seasonNumber、episodeScope（整季为NULL）、requirementDigest、sourcePackageId、sourceArtifactHandleId、sourceArtifactReferenceDigest与scopeDigest。其scopeDigest覆盖除自身外完整值，Requirement由冻结Episode scope重建；On-deck从Accepted Artifact与verified Staged成员关联生成，随Inventory/Deck摘要和原子事务提交，追加/维修revision逐字保留未变目标。其他角色/非Series为NULL，不得用NFO Episode Claim或文件名猜测替代此关系

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, reference_id, primary_ordinal, role, reference_kind(shared_external|historical_provenance), material_identity_hint, endpoint_id, location, checksum_hex`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(shelf_entry_id,inventory_revision,reference_id)`；只允许无法被单一Candidate独占的shared external reference或已完成处置后的historical provenance；Movie首次On-deck后的active Inventory不得用本表承载仍位于Material Field的exclusive Related。last-reference计算只使用active Inventory revisions及真正shared reference，不得把本表当作跳过Input Settlement的兼容路径

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, fact_kind, fact_revision, fact_schema_ref, fact_json, episode_metadata_schema_ref NULL, episode_metadata_json NULL, fact_digest, source_package_id, provenance_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: Fact JSON上限`64 KiB`；`PK(shelf_entry_id,inventory_revision,source_package_id,fact_kind,fact_revision)`；Series追加的每批Accepted Fact保留原始fact_revision/JSON/digest及source_package_id，禁止覆盖旧集资料或将不同Package的同revision误判同Fact；Arca保存Accepted Product Fact snapshot，不运行时回读Libra Store

entries.columnsContract: `relation_id, shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, person_id NULL, display_name, display_name_normalized, role, relation_source, provider_identity_schema_ref NULL, provider_identity_json NULL, provider_identity_digest NULL, origin_evidence_digest, confidence_class, relation_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(shelf_entry_id,inventory_revision,relation_id)`；同一relation lineage可在新Inventory revision保留relationId；`person_id IS NULL`是合法未注册关系；Provider JSON上限`4 KiB`且digest匹配；`UNIQUE(shelf_entry_id,inventory_revision,relation_digest)`；`INDEX(person_id,role,shelf_entry_id)`供People/Off-deck只读Projection；Aftercare只能按`6.6.2.1`确定性Evidence发布新Inventory revision，不原地PATCH历史row

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_entry_id FK, revision, state, inventory_revision, standard_revision, fact_digest, committed_at_ms`
`receipt_id PK, on_deck_run_id FK, shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, deck_fact_revision, control_revision_set_digest, related_disposition_completion_digest, commit_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(on_deck_run_id)`；只有全部Candidate Material Disposition成员均已`carried_forward|replaced_and_settled`且最终承载位于Shelf Target时才可建立；与On-deck Canonical Fact set同事务成立

entries.columnsContract: `offload_completion_id PK, on_deck_run_id FK, shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, package_id, completion_digest, committed_at_ms`

`assessment_id PK, shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, standard_revision, placement_revision, decision_fact_set_digest, care_basis_digest, assessment_kind, result, incident_key NULL, evidence_digest, assessed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `INDEX(shelf_entry_id,care_basis_digest,assessment_kind,assessed_at_ms)`；`INDEX(result,assessed_at_ms)`；同一Care Basis允许每日/每周或用户触发形成多次immutable Assessment history，`assessment_id`必须覆盖确定性cycle identity并承担重放幂等；同Inventory/Standard下Decision Fact或Placement变化仍可形成新Assessment；同一Endpoint或Provider故障以稳定`incident_key`聚合，不复制为大量独立损坏Case

entries.columnsContract: `finding_id PK, assessment_id FK, finding_kind, severity, repairability, finding_digest, state, created_at_ms`

`aftercare_case_id PK, shelf_entry_id FK, finding_set_digest, care_basis_schema_ref, care_basis_json, care_basis_digest, care_requirement_schema_ref, care_requirement_json, care_requirement_digest, case_generation INTEGER, trigger_digest, state, terminal_reason_code NULL, terminal_evidence_digest NULL, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: 两个JSON各上限`64 KiB`；同一`care_basis+finding_set+requirement`下`case_generation`从1连续递增，`trigger_digest`冻结实际Health Assessment Work与其Basis，同一trigger重放必须返回同一Case且不得重复产生Work或物理效果；相同`care_basis+finding_set+requirement`至多一个non-terminal Case；同一`shelf_entry_id`至多一个`terminal_at_ms IS NULL`的queued或active Case。queued和active时三个terminal列全NULL；`resolved|invalidated|unresolved`时三个terminal列全非NULL并write-once，必须保存精确reason和Evidence。terminal Case不会因相同trigger静默重开；新的Assessment trigger或显式用户Retry才可在相同Basis建立下一generation。Supporting Work通过Foundation反向关联；`UNIQUE(shelf_entry_id,care_basis_digest,finding_set_digest,care_requirement_digest,case_generation)`；`UNIQUE(shelf_entry_id,trigger_digest)`；`INDEX(state,created_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `correction_id PK, shelf_entry_id FK, preview_id, preview_proof_schema_ref, preview_proof_json, basis_digest, proposal_digest, placement_preview_digest, actor_id, idempotency_key, admission_digest, state(admitted|active|attention_required|committed|cancelled), state_revision, terminal_evidence_digest NULL, committed_context_schema_ref NULL, committed_context_json NULL, committed_context_digest NULL, cleanup_state(pending|active|attention_required|completed) NULL, cleanup_receipt_schema_ref NULL, cleanup_receipt_json NULL, cleanup_receipt_digest NULL, recovery_intent_schema_ref NULL, recovery_intent_json NULL, recovery_intent_digest NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms, terminal_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: preview proof固定`helix://contracts/application-types/ArcaJavCorrectionPreviewProof/v1`、JCS≤2 MiB；完整Arca Basis/新Proposal/精确旧新路径/target reality不可更新，受理不发布新Canonical Fact、不产生文件副作用。`UNIQUE(shelf_entry_id,actor_id,idempotency_key)`；`UNIQUE(shelf_entry_id) WHERE terminal_at_ms IS NULL OR cleanup_state IN (pending,active,attention_required)`；`INDEX(shelf_entry_id,state)`。仅state/state_revision/terminal evidence/timestamps可expected-state/revision CAS；admitted→active/cancelled，active→attention_required/committed，attention_required→active/cancelled；已开始正式文件Effect时不得cancelled，须恢复同一scope。terminal时Evidence/timestamp整体write-once；成功事实必须由独立Correction Inventory Commit提交，禁止以状态变化冒充成功

entries.columnsContract: `recovery_id PK, correction_id FK, shelf_entry_id FK, previous_intent_digest NULL, receipt_schema_ref, receipt_json, receipt_digest, observation_schema_ref, observation_json, observation_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；完整Receipt固定`helix://contracts/application-types/ArcaJavCorrectionRecoveryIntentReceipt/v1`、JCS≤16 KiB；完整Observation固定`helix://contracts/application-types/ArcaJavCorrectionRecoveryObservation/v1`、JCS≤1 MiB，保留实际有界执行Snapshot和逐文件/目录现场证明；摘要必须与Receipt及Correction当前指针一致。`UNIQUE(receipt_digest)`；`INDEX(correction_id,created_at_ms)`；与新Intent受理、当前指针/CAS、Command Receipt/marker/audit同事务写入；后续恢复追加历史，不覆盖旧Observation。
